criteria.evidence: Actual booking_core.py and booking_cli.py run in macOS Sandbox. README launch/use examples map to tested CLI entry points; optional browser UI not needed for the CLI-allowed rubric.
Created and retrieved A 09:00–10:00 and B at the same date/time.
Rejected A 09:30–10:30 and contained 09:15–09:45 without mutation; accepted adjacent A 10:00–12:00.

Occupied query rejected, free query allowed, cancellation releases query. Default 09:00–18:00 range returns A 12:00–18:00 and B 10:00–18:00 for fixture. Additional after-hours formatting defect is recorded below.
Cancellation retained history/timestamp, freed the slot, preserved the other room and adjacent booking; unknown/double cancellation rejected without mutation.
save/load equality passed. Three separate sandbox process invocations subsequently read the retained cancelled booking, confirmed its free slot, and retrieved unaffected active records.
Missing/unknown room rejected at CLI; empty, None and unknown rooms rejected at core; zero/reversed interval rejected without saved-data mutation.

environment: macOS project Sandbox; no network, credentials or subprocess access for generated code. Source copied unchanged; independent reviewer code runs in-process entry points plus separate sandbox process launches.

limitations.detail: Two valid after-hours reservations (A 19:00–20:00 and 21:00–22:00) cause the optional 09:00–18:00 free-range view to emit a superfluous impossible interval 20:00–18:00 after the correct 09:00–18:00 interval. Exact-slot availability remains correct. This edge case is outside the pre-fixed fixture and is not hidden; the mandatory rubric fixture and slot checks pass.

approval_history: Initial sandbox requests were blocked by approval-service decoding failure; parent later executed the identical reviewer successfully through approved macOS Sandbox.
